title: Proof of Delivery Tracking Log
subtitle: Proof Of Delivery: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Proof of Delivery Tracking Log covers delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof. The delivery verification coordinator records Proof Of Delivery events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Proof of Delivery Tracking Log keeps Proof Of Delivery exceptions visible until the delivery verification coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Proof of Delivery Tracking Log at destination address, authorized delivery point, vehicle, and custody handoff. Document delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof identity before Proof Of Delivery begins. Compare delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof findings with stated Proof Of Delivery criteria; route unresolved Proof Of Delivery issues to delivery evidence reviewer.

sections.title: Tracking period and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Proof Of Delivery, identify responsible parties, destination address, authorized delivery point, vehicle, and custody handoff, and the linked delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof source.

fields.label: Piece, package, serial, seal, and quantity
Recipient, organization, authority, and delivery-point identity

sections.title: Status variance and accountable response
sections.guidance: Capture Proof Of Delivery facts for delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Proof Of Delivery tracked controls
items: Signature, photograph, scan, or other permitted proof
Refusal, unattended delivery, or failed-attempt basis

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: For Proof Of Delivery, preserve each open variance with its current state, accountable owner, and next dated update. Delivery Verification Coordinator performs period review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Proof collection would exceed privacy policy
blocks.guidance: Pause Proof Of Delivery when recipient, location, custody, condition, or permitted proof remains unresolved. Retain the available Proof Of Delivery proof and route unresolved delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof scope to delivery verification coordinator.
